description: Round-15 checked contract for every field buildSidecar emits under cleanup and qualification. Code-owned tables must match this asset exactly; values are independently recomputed from the raw per-worker proofs and cleanup derivation, never from a previously emitted sidecar. Free-text notes and unknown extension keys are explicitly outside this contract. Snapshot digest mismatches are could-not-evaluate, not semantic failures.

legacy.basis: static subset derivation: the legacy checker compared only its listed field set, so a sidecar differing solely in unchecked cleanup/qualification mirrors had no failing checked finding
